_comment: Tier-2 for sparta rarefied_flow: 55 of the 121 keys in sparta_knowledge.json['commands'] are SPARTA documentation-page FILENAMES, not input-script commands. Feeding compute_grid / fix_ave_surf / dump_image / surf_react_adsorb / suffix to the installed binary gives 'ERROR: Unknown command: ... (../input.cpp:244)', while 'compute cg grid all all n' and 'balance_grid rcb cell' are accepted. Also gates the backend fix: validate_input used to validate against the doc index and waved the underscore forms through; it now validates against the 66 commands the build actually accepts. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). The binary probe skips when no SPARTA binary is present; the backend-side gate always runs. POSITIONAL ALIASES added 2026-08-06: this fixture's universal claims are also listed at their slots in the rarefied_flow row. The identity key 'universal:<n>' counts each shared claim once, which is correct; but an external counter walking rarefied_flow's 19 positional slots cannot see it and reports the claim as uncovered. Listing both makes the coverage visible under either convention; the gate collapses the alias onto the identity key so it is still counted once. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 rewrites the one deck line handed to validate_input as the 'bad' deck, from the doc-page form 'compute_grid all all n' to the real command form 'compute cg grid all all n', leaving the preamble, the good deck and the binary probe untouched; validate_input then returns no problems for either deck. That is also what proves the rejection is caused by the underscore form and not by something else validate_input dislikes in the surrounding deck — the assertion is bool(errors), which any unrelated complaint would satisfy. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and this expect_in_output string goes False and disappears: validate_rejects_docpage_form=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/docpage_names_are_not_commands && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line. Here specifically the binary probe skips on that line while the backend-side gate the mutation touches runs either way. POSITIONAL ALIAS REPOINTED 2026-08-07: eight new rarefied_flow claims were inserted ahead of the shared universal block, moving it from slots 9-18 to 17-26. This fixture's rarefied_flow:<n> entries are the positional spelling of the universal:<n> claims it already names by identity, so only the alias number changed; the evidence, the decks and the mutation control are untouched. The runner key moved with it: pitfall_index 18 -> 26, so this fixture still writes its own row in tier2_results.json.
_vacuity_fix: The no-binary path prints 'SKIP: no SPARTA binary found' and exits 0, and SKIP: was not forbidden — so on a machine without SPARTA this fixture PASSED having verified nothing. 'SKIP:' added to forbid_in_output so an absent binary records a failure instead of a false pass. Same defect knowledge/kratos-sparta fixed in generators_execute_on_installed_build; the gate found eight more.
